decisions.reason: The ID Vault was launched only in August 2023 as a feature within the super-app platform, so its prospects are still uncertain and it costs little to keep, which makes it worth holding as an option.

The identity-bound wallet is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with the payment framework, which raises the chance it gets folded in, but its low upkeep favors keeping it while its value is unresolved.

The NFC tag authenticator is a niche hardware-related item that is only mentioned on the website, so its value is uncertain, but keeping it is cheap and it complements the firm's core authentication strengths.
The secure payment and wallet framework has its own page and fits the super-app strategy, signaling commitment and early positive evidence.
The multi-service mobile app platform is essentially the firm's core super-app offering, so dropping it is unlikely.
The application shielding library has its own page and draws on the firm's long application-security expertise, making it a low-cost option worth keeping.
